newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - YPF raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - YPF raised to buy.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said on Wednesday that it had raised its rating for Argentine oil company YPF S.A. to buy from long-term buy.

-- In the third quarter, YPF's operating profit rose by 53 percent to $446 million from $291 million in the same period of 1995, with operating margins of 28.4 percent against 21.6 percent during the period a year ago, analysts Jose Costa Buck and Gonzalo Pangano wrote in a report.

-- "We are upgrading our recommendation on YPF from long-term buy to buy since we believe that YPF's excellent performance, attractive set of investment opportunities in Latin America, rising oil production and a more-than- satisfactory performance from (its Maxus Energy Corp subsidiary) will improve investor sentiment on the stock," they wrote.
-- YPF's stock fell 1/4 to 22-3/4 in New York trade on Wednesday.
